# Icon assets

UI icons are official Tabler Icons v3.47.0 by Paweł Kuna, used under the MIT license.

Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/tree/v3.47.0/icons
License: icons/tabler/LICENSE

The SVG geometry is retained verbatim. Icons are rendered from local files using CSS masks so their colors follow the interface. The favicon and app mark use Tabler's filled dashboard icon on the app's charcoal background with amber fill.
